characterSlots.label: The child
characterSlots.description: A child about 6 years old who sails the boat

characterSlots.label: A grown-up
characterSlots.description: A parent or grandparent who folds the boat

text.content: After the rain, {{hero.name}} and {{grownup.title}} folded yesterday’s newspaper into a boat with a pointy sail. “The pond!” {{hero.name}} pointed, and off they went.
{{hero.name}} knelt and set the boat down on the water. It wobbled. It turned. Then the wind found its sail, and away it went.
They sat on the bank and watched it sail all afternoon, all the way to the willow island. “It’s exploring,” said {{grownup.title}}. {{hero.They}} waved until the sky turned pink.
